evidence.description: The property getter and setter directly use UserDefaults.standard to read and persist a preference.
The notification-settings callback directly invokes User.shared.updatePushNotificationUserStateWithAnalytics and reads User.shared.analyticsUserState.

candidates.explanation: Analytics directly obtains operational dependencies through UserDefaults.standard and User.shared rather than receiving them through an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The endpoint is selected from urlProvider.snowplowMicro or urlProvider.snowplow and immediately passed as endpoint! without optional validation.

candidates.explanation: makeNetworkConfig force-unwraps the selected endpoint without a visible guarantee that either URL-provider value is non-nil.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
